Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,707.29 up 35.50 points August 01, 2018, 04:45:16 PM
Wednesday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,707.29. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.3 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 1.07 to 1 ratio. There were 1454 advancers and 1556 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 39 stocks reached a 52 week high and 49 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page.
The NASDAQ 100 index closed up .57% for the day; a total of 40.91 points. The current value is 7,272.89. Baidu, Inc. ( BIDU ) had the largest percent change down (-7.73%) while Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change gain rising 5.89%. The Dow Jones index closed down -.32% for the day; a total of -81.37 points. The current value is 25,333.82. Caterpillar, Inc.
